title: These ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Temporary Tattoos Let You Rep Your Favorite Characters and Display Glow-in-the-Dark Demon Markings
summary: The temporary tattoos apply easily to the skin with water and wash off with soap or rubbing alcohol.
contentText:

There’s a new way for KPop Demon Hunters fans to show their love and devotion to the Netflix animated film.

Amazon just dropped a set of colorful temporary tattoos inspired by the hit movie musical . Right now, you can pick up a pack of 50 tattoos that pay homage to the film’s two main singing groups — HUNTR/X and Saja Boys — as well as the supernatural tiger Derpy.

FUN FAN MERCH

Demon Hunters Movie-Inspired Tattoos

50-Pack

$6.99 $8.99 22% off

Buy Now On Amazon

The tattoos range in dimensions, though most of them are about the size of a small sticky note .

The temporary tattoos apply easily to the skin with water. Simply peel off the protective film covering the tattoo that you want, press the tattoo against your skin and then apply a light coating of water on top. Hold down for about 30 seconds (pressing with light to medium pressure) and then gently remove the backing paper to transfer.

Amazon says these are non-toxic tattoos and can be removed easily with soap, rubbing alcohol or baby oil. Reviewers say the tattoos last about a day and hold up to light hand washing but fade in the bath or shower.

These KPop Demon Hunters -inspired tats are great for goodie bags, Halloween costumes and white elephant gifts alike. Or you can just pick them up for play — and cosplay — time. Pick up the fan-made merch on Amazon here . The site says more than 400 shoppers have purchased the temporary tattoo set in the last few weeks alone.

ALSO AVAILABLE

Demon Mark Tattoos

Suitable for body and face

$6.99

More than 3,000 people, meantime, have picked up this Demon Hunters -inspired set in the last month, per Amazon.

The temporary tattoos recreate the demon markings that form a major plot point in the film. What we like: the iridescent press-on tattoos glow in the dark, and reviewers say they last up to 48 hours.

OFFICIAL STICKER SET

KPop Demon Hunters Sticker Set

1,500 stickers

$5.99

Looking for more options? You can pick up this set of KPop Demon Hunters stickers, which feature all of the film’s characters across 20 sticker sheets. There are 1,500 stickers in total.

The stickers come in mini, regular and “jumbo” sizes (about the size of a regular Post-It note ), and the set also includes Korean alphabet stickers, in addition to memorable scenes and phrases from the movie. This is an officially-licensed release from Netflix and great for decorating notebooks, laptops, phone cases and gift boxes — though really, the applications are endless.

The KPop Demon Hunters temporary tattoos and stickers come on the heels of a flurry of merchandise releases from the film, including official toys , Mattel dolls and even bedroom pillows and accessories . The movie, meanwhile, is set to get a physical release on Blu-ray/DVD later this year .
